ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
sage-data-polytopes packages the two- and three-dimensional reflexive
polytope catalogues and the corresponding PALP databases as Python
resources. The four-dimensional database is not included. It is the
Python-resource successor to the legacy sagemath-db-polytopes conda
package, which installs the same data into a shared prefix; both layouts
can coexist during migration.
about.summary: Databases of two- and three-dimensional reflexive polytopes for SageMath

tests.script: python -c "import sage_data_polytopes as data; assert data.reflexive_polytopes(2).is_file(); assert data.reflexive_polytopes(3).is_file(); assert data.palp_database(2).joinpath('zzdb.info').is_file(); assert data.palp_database(3).joinpath('zzdb.info').is_file(); data.verify_data()"

name: sage-data-polytopes
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "20170220.0"

package:
  name: sage-data-polytopes
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/s/sage-data-polytopes/sage_data_polytopes-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 46ad7658853f28236ccc1f0cbecad4f43ff5b152fb7fb72fcf29158d8d71dc97

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - sage_data_polytopes
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - python -c "import sage_data_polytopes as data; assert data.reflexive_polytopes(2).is_file(); assert data.reflexive_polytopes(3).is_file(); assert data.palp_database(2).joinpath('zzdb.info').is_file(); assert data.palp_database(3).joinpath('zzdb.info').is_file(); data.verify_data()"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/cxzhong/sage-data-polytopes
  repository: https://github.com/cxzhong/sage-data-polytopes
  summary: Databases of two- and three-dimensional reflexive polytopes for SageMath
  description: |
    sage-data-polytopes packages the two- and three-dimensional reflexive
    polytope catalogues and the corresponding PALP databases as Python
    resources. The four-dimensional database is not included. It is the
    Python-resource successor to the legacy sagemath-db-polytopes conda
    package, which installs the same data into a shared prefix; both layouts
    can coexist during migration.
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - DATA_LICENSES.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - cxzhong
